# PR-GAS-099 Purging Test Mains

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Document ID | PR-GAS-099 |
| Version | 1 |

FICTIONAL DOCUMENT. Test fixture only.

## 6 Procedure

### 6.1 Isolation

6.1.1 Confirm the main is isolated at both ends and the isolation is recorded on the permit.

6.1.2 Fit blanking plates to both ends of the section to be purged.

### 6.2 Vent stack

WARNING: Vented gas can drift at low level in still weather and reach an ignition source.

6.2.1 Erect the vent stack at least 2.5 m above ground level.

6.2.2 Set out a 5 m exclusion zone around the vent and keep vehicles out of it.

### 6.3 Purge to gas

HOLD POINT: Do not admit gas until the Authorised Person (Gas) has signed the purge record.

6.3.1 Open the inlet valve slowly and monitor the vent with a calibrated gas detector.
